title: A single AI forecast inflates US power auctions by $5.7B
summary: Australia's latest inflation figures showed that prices in the category covering audio, visual, and computing equipment rose 6.1% in a single quarter. That's by far the largest increase in the Australian Bureau of Statistics series, which began in 1980.
